name: AccessRequest
description: Private server-maintained workflow snapshot for a public access request

contact_email.description: Normalized email linking this workflow snapshot to the authoritative Buildy Contact

contact_id.description: Optional authoritative Buildy Contact id when available

name.description: Bounded name snapshot from the submitted request

submitted_at.description: Server timestamp when the request entered the workflow

status.description: Workflow status: NEW, REVIEWED, or APPROVED

private_note.description: Bounded private note visible only to authorized administrators

reviewed_by.description: Administrator actor recorded when the request is reviewed

reviewed_at.description: Server timestamp when the request was reviewed

approved_by.description: Administrator actor recorded when the request is approved

approved_at.description: Server timestamp when the request was approved
